_comment: Anima caps-based inline sampling. caps.positive/caps.negative are PLACEHOLDER paths -> point each at a CACHE-ENTRY-SHAPED safetensors carrying key 'context_cond' shape [1,LT,1024] (LT<=512, Qwen3 LLM-adapter cross-attn context; the trainer truncates/zero-pads to 256 tokens). Produce via pipeline/anima_text_context.mojo (writes context_cond) or the anima cache precache. width/height = the binary's native 128px preview (enforce_min_image_size false because <1024). cfg 4.5 uses caps.negative (falls back to zeros if omitted).
